top.title: LQDA Settles UTHR Disputes for $380.7M, Limits Yutrepia Label
top.summary: Liquidia Corporation has reached a global settlement with United Therapeutics, resolving all six pending legal disputes and ensuring continued access to Yutrepia for PAH patients. However, the company must pay $380.7 million in settlement obligations across 2026-2027, and the removal of the PH-ILD indication from Yutrepia's label narrows its approved use. The company reported preliminary Q3 2026 Yutrepia sales of $222.7 million and plans to advance pipeline candidate L606.

top.title: Syndax Stock Falls 16% as Phase II Fibrosis Study Misses Primary Goal
top.summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals (SNDX) shares fell 15.7% after its phase II MAXPIRe study of axatilimab failed to meet the primary endpoint in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) treatment. The drug showed no benefit in slowing FVC decline, though it maintained a favorable safety profile. The company is discontinuing IPF development but will continue pursuing axatilimab in chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) with results expected in 2026 and 2028.

top.title: BMY Reports Mixed Phase III Trial Results, Stock Down
top.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced mixed Phase III results for admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, meeting its primary endpoint only at the 60-mg dose while failing at 120-mg, causing the stock to decline 2.6%. However, the company reported positive Phase III results for RYZ101 in advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, demonstrating statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival. The mixed outcomes reflect uncertainty about admilparant's dose consistency despite favorable safety profiles.

top.title: Here's Why You Should Add ANRO Stock to Your Portfolio Now
top.summary: Alto Neuroscience (ANRO), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, is advancing its precision psychiatry pipeline with three key candidates. ALTO-207 for treatment-resistant depression showed encouraging phase IIa results, with phase IIb results expected in H2 2027. ALTO-300 and ALTO-100 are in phase IIb studies with top-line results expected in H1 2027 and mid-2027 respectively. ALTO-101 for schizophrenia-related cognitive impairment failed its primary endpoint but showed some secondary signals. Year-to-date, ANRO shares have risen 24.1%, outperforming the biotech industry's 2.9% growth.

Investors who purchased shares during the class periods have until the specified deadlines to request lead plaintiff status.

gex_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within 1d of monthly OPEX — charm/vanna flows dominate; wait for post-OPEX
reasons.zh: 距月度期权到期 1 天 — charm/vanna 资金流主导；等到期后再确认

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.8 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.8 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Hotter CPI Sends Futures Lower as Yields Jump
top.summary: September CPI data revealed inflation re-acceleration to +3.7% year-over-year, the highest since May, causing pre-market futures to turn negative. Core CPI also came in hotter than expected at +0.3% month-over-month and +2.6% year-over-year. Bond yields rose significantly across all maturities. Q3 earnings from major financial firms showed mixed results, with Morgan Stanley and BlackRock beating expectations while Bank of America and Progressive missed or underperformed.

top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Beta Bionics, Inc. for alleged securities fraud. The complaint alleges that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding FDA observations about its iLet Bionic Pancreas insulin pump, including undisclosed quality management deficiencies and unreported serious customer injuries. Investors who purchased Beta Bionics securities between July 30, 2025 and February 24, 2026 are encouraged to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 3, 2026.

top.title: Better Home & Finance (BETR) Faces Securities Class Action Amid 75% Sequential Increase in Net Loss, Dimmed Loan Volume Prospects
top.summary: Better Home & Finance faces a securities class action lawsuit after reporting a 75% sequential increase in net loss for Q1 2026 and drastically missing its $1 billion monthly loan volume target by 45%, achieving only $550 million per month. The company had previously assured investors it would reach the $1 billion target by May 2026, but failed to disclose that conversion rates were already slowing due to macroeconomic factors. The stock plunged 28% on May 7, 2026, and the CEO was subsequently fired.

top.title: Deadline Alert: Better Home & Finance Holding Company (BETR) Shareholders Who Lost Money Urged To Contact Glancy Prongay Wolke & Rotter LLP About Securities Fraud Lawsuit
top.summary: A class action securities fraud lawsuit has been filed against Better Home & Finance Holding Company (BETR) for allegedly making false statements about its business performance. The company failed to disclose that its conversion funnel was slowing and that its $1 billion monthly loan volume target would be deferred. The stock fell 28.5% on May 7, 2026 when the company revealed lower-than-expected guidance and conversion rate declines. Investors who purchased BETR securities between March 13 and May 7, 2026 are urged to contact the law firm by November 20, 2026 to participate in the lawsuit.

top.title: BETR Shareholder Alert: Better Home & Finance Holding Company Securities Class Action Lawsuit - Investors With Losses May Contact SueWallSt
top.summary: A securities class action has been filed against Better Home & Finance Holding Company (BETR) alleging the company made materially misleading statements about its AI-driven lending partnerships and conversion rates. The lawsuit claims management failed to disclose that loan conversion rates had already begun slowing due to macroeconomic factors while presenting an optimistic partnership growth outlook. BETR shares fell 28.5% ($12.17 per share) on May 7, 2026, after the company disclosed declining conversion rates and deferred its $1 billion monthly funded volume target. The lead plaintiff deadline is November 20, 2026.

top.summary: September CPI data revealed inflation re-acceleration to +3.7% year-over-year, the highest since May, causing pre-market futures to turn negative. Q3 earnings from major financial firms showed mixed results, with Morgan Stanley and BlackRock beating expectations while Bank of America and Progressive missed or underperformed.

top.title: CPI Jumps Back to Spring Levels, Pre-Markets Fall
top.summary: September CPI data showed inflation re-accelerating to 3.7% year-over-year and 0.6% month-over-month, the highest rates since spring, triggering a market selloff with pre-market futures turning red and bond yields rising sharply. top.title: BLK Q3 Earnings Beat, Stock Gains Pre-Market on Revenue & AUM Growth

ETFs and active strategies attracted strong inflows, though elevated expenses remain a challenge.

top.title: Chevron & Shell Lead U.S. Gulf Oil Production Recovery After Hurricane
top.summary: Major U.S. oil producers Chevron, Shell, and BP are resuming offshore operations in the Gulf following Hurricane Isaias. The companies had shut in 1.3 million barrels per day (63% of regional production) before the storm. All three reported no significant damage to key facilities and are redeploying workers to restore full production, easing supply concerns for the U.S. energy market.

top.title: Kinder Morgan Restores US-Mexico Gas Flows After Pipeline Outage
top.summary: Kinder Morgan (KMI) has resumed natural gas deliveries to Mexico through its Tennessee Gas Pipeline following infrastructure repairs. The company lifted its force majeure declaration after resolving operational issues affecting cross-border shipments. Mexico's heavy reliance on U.S. natural gas imports for electricity generation and industrial use supports steady demand for KMI's transportation services.

top.title: Syndax Stock Falls 16% as Phase II Fibrosis Study Misses Primary Goal
top.summary: Syndax Pharmaceuticals (SNDX) shares fell 15.7% after its phase II MAXPIRe study of axatilimab failed to meet the primary endpoint in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) treatment. The drug showed no benefit in slowing FVC decline, though it maintained a favorable safety profile. The company is discontinuing IPF development but will continue pursuing axatilimab in chronic graft-versus-host disease (cGVHD) with results expected in 2026 and 2028.

top.title: BMY Reports Mixed Phase III Trial Results, Stock Down
top.summary: Bristol Myers Squibb announced mixed Phase III results for admilparant in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, meeting its primary endpoint only at the 60-mg dose while failing at 120-mg, causing the stock to decline 2.6%. However, the company reported positive Phase III results for RYZ101 in advanced gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine tumors, demonstrating statistically significant improvement in progression-free survival. The mixed outcomes reflect uncertainty about admilparant's dose consistency despite favorable safety profiles.

top.title: Here's Why You Should Add ANRO Stock to Your Portfolio Now
top.summary: Alto Neuroscience (ANRO), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company, is advancing its precision psychiatry pipeline with three key candidates. ALTO-207 for treatment-resistant depression showed encouraging phase IIa results, with phase IIb results expected in H2 2027. ALTO-300 and ALTO-100 are in phase IIb studies with top-line results expected in H1 2027 and mid-2027 respectively. ALTO-101 for schizophrenia-related cognitive impairment failed its primary endpoint but showed some secondary signals. Year-to-date, ANRO shares have risen 24.1%, outperforming the biotech industry's 2.9% growth.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -8.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -8.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: A. O. Smith Corporation increased its quarterly dividend by 6% to 38 cents per share, continuing over 30 years of consecutive dividend hikes. top.title: Here's Why It is Appropriate to Invest in Emerson Right Now
top.summary: Emerson Electric (EMR) demonstrates strong growth momentum with 6% underlying sales increase and 7% order growth in Q3 fiscal 2026. Strong free cash flow of $2.62 billion supports shareholder returns through dividends and share buybacks, with a recent 5% dividend increase.

top.title: Fastenal Q3 Earnings Beat on Expense Leverage, Sales Miss Estimates
top.summary: Fastenal Company reported Q3 2026 earnings of 35 cents per share, beating consensus by 2.9% and growing 19.8% year-over-year, but net sales of $2.46 billion missed estimates by 1%. The company benefited from contract customer growth (18.8% daily sales increase), pricing actions (240 bps contribution), and operating margin expansion to 21.5%, though gross margin faced pressure from a mix shift toward larger customers. FAST stock declined 6.2% in pre-market trading following the announcement.

top.title: Forgent Stock Up 30% Since Strong Q4: Buy for More Upside?

top.title: Fluence Energy (FLNC) Faces Securities Class Action Amid Inability to Ramp Houston Facility – HBSS
top.summary: Fluence Energy (NASDAQ: FLNC) is facing a securities class action lawsuit for allegedly misleading investors about its ability to capitalize on data center energy storage demand. The company failed to disclose that its revenue delivery depended on incomplete manufacturing facilities and that remediation efforts were unsuccessful. A series of earnings announcements between February and September 2026 revealed production issues, delayed project deliveries, and manufacturing problems, causing the stock to plunge 73% and wiping out approximately $3 billion in market capitalization.

top.title: Vattenfall beauftragt Fluence mit 1 GWh-Batteriespeicher am Standort Brunsbüttel
top.summary: Vattenfall and Fluence Energy have signed a contract for a 254 MW / 1,000+ MWh battery storage system in Brunsbüttel, Germany, one of the largest battery projects in the country. The facility will be built at the decommissioned Brunsbüttel nuclear power plant site and is expected to become operational by end of 2028, utilizing Fluence's Gridstack Pro 5000 platform. The project will nearly double Vattenfall's existing battery capacity and support grid stability and renewable energy integration.

top.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges Fluence Energy, Inc Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Fluence Energy, Inc. alleging that the company made materially false and misleading statements regarding its ability to deliver backlog and meet fiscal 2026 guidance. The complaint claims that production problems at contract manufacturing facilities were not resolved and that a material portion of backlog would not be delivered as promised. Investors who purchased securities between November 24, 2025 and September 16, 2026 may be eligible to join the case, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 30, 2026.

Following a Hunterbrook Media report on October 2, 2026, MRP's stock fell 8.5% to $22.51. top.title: Mirum's Livmarli Meets Phase III Goal in Ultra-Rare Liver Diseases
top.summary: Mirum Pharmaceuticals announced that its Phase III EXPAND study met the primary endpoint for Livmarli (maralixibat) in treating cholestatic pruritus in patients with ultra-rare cholestatic liver diseases. Livmarli showed a 1.81-point improvement in itch severity versus 0.83 for placebo and achieved a 69% reduction in serum bile acids. The company plans to submit a supplemental new drug application to the FDA in the first half of 2027. Livmarli sales have grown 50.2% year-over-year in the first half of 2026, reaching $242.5 million.

With $1.21B in cash and no debt, NXT trades at 17.04X forward earnings but carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating due to mixed signals on durability.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

While the company reported 45% revenue growth in Q2 2026, persistent $42.8 million net losses, negative cash flow of $60 million in H1 2026, and integration risks from the LivePerson acquisition weigh on investor confidence. Despite a lower valuation multiple of 7.68X forward P/S versus the industry's 12.02X, analysts maintain a Sell rating, citing the need for clearer evidence of sustainable profitability before recovery.

top.title: SoundHound Eyes 25 Fortune 100 Brands: Can LivePerson Unlock Scale?
top.summary: SoundHound AI completed its acquisition of LivePerson in September 2026, gaining access to 25 Fortune 100 brands and over $500M in future revenue potential. The combined company integrates voice AI with digital messaging across multiple channels. However, SoundHound faces integration risks, significant cash burn ($60M in H1 2026), and intensifying competition from Five9 and NICE in the enterprise AI space. Despite 45% revenue growth and a debt-free balance sheet, the company remains unprofitable with a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.

Despite the daily pullback, the stock has a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating with strong fundamentals: projected Q3 earnings of $4.77 per share (up 367.65% YoY), full-year earnings guidance of $8.86 per share (up 187.66%), and a Forward P/E of 3.43, well below the industry average of 9.89. Analyst estimates have surged 181.27% over the last 30 days.
